      <title>Trends from Money20/20 2026: The rise of “hidden” financial services </title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/trends-from-money20-20-2026-the-rise-of-hidden-financial-services</link>
      <description>As fintech products become increasingly capable, the infrastructure behind them fades into the background. Three trends from Money20/20 show how stablecoins, agents, and always-on money are changing financial services. </description>

      <title>Stripe survey: Four trends reshaping how SaaS platforms compete in the AI era</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/saas-platform-trends-in-AI-era</link>

    <item>
      <title>New ways for fintechs to move money and expand globally</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/new-ways-for-fintechs-to-move-money-and-expand-globally</link>
      <description>We’re introducing three updates to help fintechs launch products and grow internationally more easily: simpler payout management with Stripe Global Payouts, support for stablecoin cards in more countries, and unified APIs for building global financial products. </description>
      <enclosure url="https://images.ctfassets.net/fzn2n1nzq965/eKftRVNsIvc86x4rTK06w/9f89d806876c97cb253098c787818baf/Index_image__appears_on_the_blog_index_page_._Specs__1250x1250px_with_padding__2_.png"

    <item>
      <title>Sync real-time Stripe data to Postgres with Stripe Data Pipeline</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/real-time-stripe-data-postgres</link>
      <description>Applications rely on current Stripe data to fulfill orders, update customer accounts, and manage access to paid features. Until now, developers have had to build and maintain custom integrations to keep application databases in sync with Stripe. We’re introducing real-time sync to Postgres for Stripe Data Pipeline, which lets them keep databases current without having to build custom integrations.</description>
      <enclosure url="https://images.ctfassets.net/fzn2n1nzq965/7BvPW4nQ9gdzqnXQNUaKbw/4d4152e6698fbe360fb753ff31ace6c2/Index_image__appears_on_the_blog_index_page_._Specs__1250x1250px_with_padding.png"

      <dc:date>2026-10-15T00:00:00+00:00</dc:date>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>The “alien” economics of AI monetization</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/economics-of-ai-monetization</link>
      <description>As usage, costs, and customer expectations change, AI companies are moving beyond traditional SaaS pricing. Leaders at Monetize 2026 shared how they’re combining subscriptions with usage-based billing, building spend controls into products, adapting packaging and value metrics, and making pricing readable for both human and AI buyers.</description>
      <enclosure url="https://images.ctfassets.net/fzn2n1nzq965/6kxvuJDHvg9cCTNLuACl0o/64b5443480f21fa7ea93c3aded30b8ee/Index_image__-_Kyle.png"

      <dc:date>2026-10-13T00:00:00+00:00</dc:date>
    </item>
    <item>
      <title>Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/where-pricing-is-headed</link>
      <description>Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model. Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.</description>
      <enclosure url="https://images.ctfassets.net/fzn2n1nzq965/429O97zRn17cvoY9EQIuoO/17adb35450f60d6ddd613c04cca873f4/1250x1250.jpg"

    <item>
      <title>OUSD is now the default stablecoin on Stripe</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/ousd-now-live-on-stripe</link>
      <description>Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin built for global money movement, is now available across Stripe. Businesses can use OUSD to manage funds, make payments, and offer new financial services.</description>
      <enclosure url="https://images.ctfassets.net/fzn2n1nzq965/2YSRP4aCTTxIcUOn1lu4Qq/187eabba0a9b39e79b4c228b89812493/Square__4_.jpg"

      <title>Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link </title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/helping-personal-agents-shop-more-intelligently-and-reliably-with-link</link>
      <description>As agents take on more purchases, agent builders have increasingly asked us to help agents navigate checkout and earn consumer trust. Today, we’re sharing three major improvements to support this broader set of needs.</description>

    <item>
      <title>Travel’s AI dilemma at Skift Global Forum</title>
      <link>https://stripe.com/blog/travels-ai-dilemma-at-skift-global-forum</link>
      <description>At the “great recalibration”-themed travel conference, Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky called AI “an existential risk” to his company and “literally the best thing to ever happen” to it in the same discussion. That sums up many travel leaders’ push-and-pull relationship with AI. </description>

      <title>New trends in global card fraud: How 3D Secure and regional mandates are affecting risk </title>
